name: social_sentiment_orthogonal
economic_meaning: Social-media investor sentiment (z-score of tweet sentiment). High sentiment -> short-run return continuation (sentiment/attention premium; Antweiler-Frank 2004, Da-Engelberg-Gao 2011). Long high-sentiment, short low-sentiment.
orthogonality: Pure social-media behavioral data, daily. Structurally uncorrelated with (a) the model16 fscore value composite (fundamental, quarterly) and (b) the option put/call IV factor (institutional hedging). Different data source + horizon.
robustness: Sign stable & positive across TOP500/TOP3000 and decay 6/10. Single field, no ts_backfill (daily dense field).
caveat: SH 0.63 < 1.25 LOW_SHARPE submission floor -- consistent with the established non-option ceiling on this account tier. Satisfies the requested properties (simple, regularized, economic, orthogonal) but does not by itself clear the WQ submission gate.
